title: answers
description: The node answers and stub values the recorded scenarios of one directory share, each once, under its digest. A recorded scenario's `expect.nodes` and `sharedStubs` name a value here by its digest instead of writing it again. It is answers.json at the top of a recorded directory (scenarios/rehearsed/, scenarios/edges/), written by the command that records there; regenerate it, never edit it.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/answers.schema.json.

description.description: What this file is, written by the command that wrote it.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

generated.description: The command that wrote this file and owns the directory it sits in. It writes the file whole each time it records, so a value no scenario points to is never kept.

nodes.description: Each distinct node answer of the scenarios in this directory, once, under its digest.

stubs.description: Each distinct stub value of the scenarios in this directory, once, under its digest.
